caption: Overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs in the ABS-AOS pattern. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{GM} [55, 61]), Tier-2 (OP_{GM} [41, 49]), and Tier-3 (OP_{GM} [25, 27]).
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the overall performance percentage of various large language models (LLMs) in the ABS-AOS pattern, comparing their performance across different categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, which are unlabeled and appear to represent different LLMs, listed in a specific order. The vertical axis is labeled "Overall Performance (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Each category is represented by a pair or triplet of bars, with different colors indicating different tiers: green and pink for Tier-1, purple, blue, and gray for Tier-2, and blue and brown for Tier-3. The bars have approximate values ranging from 24.64% to 61.09%, with the tallest bars (green and pink) representing Tier-1 LLMs with values of 61.09% and 60.72%, and the shortest bars (blue and brown) representing Tier-3 LLMs with values of 24.64% and 27.22%. The bars are grouped together, with no clear sorting order among the categories. The chart provides a visual representation of the performance distribution of LLMs across different tiers, with Tier-1 models generally performing better than Tier-2 and Tier-3 models.
